Add a postcondition that captures the core logic: S can be transformed into P if and only if the number of differing bits between S and P is divisible by 3, and the differing bits can be resolved by grouping into triplets where each triplet contains at least one 0 and one 1 in S (or equivalently, the differing bits can be adjusted via the allowed operations).
